key: ???: Okay, thank you very much!\nI'll see you when we get into the city.
en: ???: Okay, thank you very much!\nI'll see you when we get into the city.
ja: ???: はい　どうも　ありがとうございます!\nまた　街に着いたら　お会いしましょう。

key: ???: All right, hello there!
en: ???: All right, hello there!
ja: ???: はい　こんにちは!

key: Your turn now; sorry for the wait.
en: Your turn now; sorry for the wait.
ja: お待たせしました　次は　あなたの番です。

key: My name's Ame.\nI'm the manager of the Reborn League.
en: My name's Ame.\nI'm the manager of the Reborn League.
ja: わたしの名前は　アメ。\nリボーンリーグの　マネージャーです。

key: You were also looking to sign up for it, right?
en: You were also looking to sign up for it, right?
ja: あなたも　登録を　希望されてたんですよね?

key: It would be great if so! We're finally just getting things off the ground again.
en: It would be great if so! We're finally just getting things off the ground again.
ja: そうだと　うれしいです! やっと　また　立て直しが　始まったところなので。

key: Truth is, after the incident a few years ago, the whole region was almost completely abandoned... even by the Pokémon.
en: Truth is, after the incident a few years ago, the whole region was almost completely abandoned... even by the Pokémon.
ja: 実は　数年前の事件のあと　この地方は　ほとんど　見捨てられてしまって……　ポケモンにさえ。

key: ...Uh, but! Don't let that worry you!
en: ...Uh, but! Don't let that worry you!
ja: ……あ　でも! 心配しないでくださいね!

key: It might not be an ideal place, but our Gym Leaders are like nothing you've ever seen before, and I think you'll find Reborn to be a region like no other too!
en: It might not be an ideal place, but our Gym Leaders are like nothing you've ever seen before, and I think you'll find Reborn to be a region like no other too!
ja: 理想的な場所じゃないかも　しれませんが　うちのジムリーダーたちは　今までに　見たことないようなメンバーですし　リボーンも　他にはない地方だと　わかっていただけると　思います!

key: I'm coming back from some business out of town, so I figured I might as well introduce myself early and get a head start on everyone's registration.
en: I'm coming back from some business out of town, so I figured I might as well introduce myself early and get a head start on everyone's registration.
ja: 街の外での用事から　戻る途中なので　早めに　自己紹介して　みなさんの登録を　先に　進めておこうと　思いまして。

key: Could I see your boarding ticket, please?
en: Could I see your boarding ticket, please?
ja: 乗車券を　見せていただけますか?

key: Hmm... \PN.
en: Hmm... \PN.
ja: うーん……\PN。

key: I guess it's that time already, huh?
en: I guess it's that time already, huh?
ja: もう　そんな時期なんですね。

key: Well, okay, I've got you down.
en: Well, okay, I've got you down.
ja: よし　登録しました。

key: Now, if you don't know what I'm talking about, just feel free to skip this...
en: Now, if you don't know what I'm talking about, just feel free to skip this...
ja: さて　もし　わたしの言ってることが　わからなければ　遠慮なく　これは　飛ばしてください……

key: But were there any special instructions or passwords you had for us?
en: But were there any special instructions or passwords you had for us?
ja: 何か　特別な指示や　合言葉は　ありましたか?

key: AME: I'm sorry, I'm not sure what that would be?
en: AME: I'm sorry, I'm not sure what that would be?
ja: アメ: すみません　それが　何なのか　よくわからなくて?

key: Would you like to try again?
en: Would you like to try again?
ja: もう一度　試しますか?

key: AME: Got it! Will there be anything else?
en: AME: Got it! Will there be anything else?
ja: アメ: わかりました! 他に　何か　ありますか?

key: AME: All set, then.
en: AME: All set, then.
ja: アメ: それでは　準備　完了です。

key: We're almost to Grandview Station, so after we disembark, just follow me to the Grand Hall.
en: We're almost to Grandview Station, so after we disembark, just follow me to the Grand Hall.
ja: もうすぐ　グランドビュー駅ですので　降りたら　大ホールまで　わたしについてきてください。

key: There, I'll give you a starter Pokémon to really kick off your adventure in Reborn. Sound good?
en: There, I'll give you a starter Pokémon to really kick off your adventure in Reborn. Sound good?
ja: そこで　リボーンでの冒険を　本格的に始めるための　最初のポケモンを　お渡しします。よろしいですか?

key: Then if you'll--
en: Then if you'll--
ja: それでは――

key: Um.
en: Um.
ja: あの。

key: AME: Something's not right...
en: AME: Something's not right...
ja: アメ: 何か　おかしいです……

key: Shouldn't we be decelerating already?
en: Shouldn't we be decelerating already?
ja: もう　減速してないと　おかしいですよね?

key: Oh no-- move!
en: Oh no-- move!
ja: だめ――　どいて!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
